answer: Let a quill be one clone. trellis is the only registry binding key, endpoint and branch path, so duplicates merge; it grows one branch per epoch. Activation k needs a quorum from k trellis branches whose common fork is at least k epochs back, one vote per branch per epoch, and every voter burns spiral equal to that fork distance into the quill record. n quill therefore need triangular branch depth over serial epochs and about n^3 spiral, not rentable. It breaks if trellis backdates forks, reuses branches, or spiral transfers.
